text: よくばるのは　よそう…

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about. よくばるのは = 'being greedy'.

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: The おう ending on a verb says 'let's do it' or 'I think I will'. よす means to drop something, so よそう = 'let's not'.
